component.name: Vela
component.summary: Lightweight native JMAP email client for COSMIC

description.p: Vela is a calm, native three-pane email client built in Rust with libcosmic and JMAP (RFC 8620 / 8621), targeting Stalwart and Fastmail.

ul.li: Three-pane COSMIC UI with collapsible sidebar, resizable panes, and keyboard triage
Standalone Settings window and pop-out conversation windows with triage toolbars
Multi-account JMAP support with OS Keyring (Secret Service) credential storage
Encrypted SQLCipher (AES-256) local cache with FTS5 full-text search and incremental sync
Selectable read-only message bodies, privacy-first remote image blocking, and attachment downloads
Built-in headless MCP server (vela-mcp) with read-only and triage modes

description.p: Initial COSMIC JMAP client prototype with multi-account support, encrypted SQLCipher cache, selectable message bodies, pop-out thread windows, and vela-mcp.
